D-1.rationale: Owner rejected early honestly-labelled G2-S canary. Peerit blind migration and direct-blind-g2s public canary wait until advanced blind profiles are ready. NOTE: tension with D-3 (G3 deferred) and D-4 (self-ops only) — define which advanced profile unblocks first canary (e.g. OHTTP with independent operator only).

D-2.rationale: OHTTP / split-web claims require a separate ingress operator with independent control, keys, hosts, deploy access, logs, and failure domain. Same-operator OHTTP may prove mechanics only; effective claim remains G2-S until independence is real.

D-3.rationale: No G3 product commitment or marketing until repair ownership, payment, cadence, offline-writer behavior, and repair-hint authenticity are defined and evidenced.

D-4.rationale: No third-party storage operator recruitment until a full jurisdiction-aware operator policy pack exists. For now only self-operated relays. Blocks independent-operator and multi-operator collusion claims.

D-5.rationale: Public HTTPS gateway is the separately named public-t1-gateway / public-gateway-v1 product for exact-byte public app distribution. It must not inherit blind privacy claims.

D-6.rationale: Do not freeze K_partition into store layout. Prefer simpler recovery. Revisit only if measured cross-relay privacy benefit justifies a tested backup/rotation/recovery contract.

D-7.rationale: After the first successful blind-only write, rollback is only to a dual-read build that understands blind + legacy. Legacy-only binaries are not a valid recovery path.

plainLanguageSummary.D-1: Do not ship a half-private G2-S canary first; wait for stronger advanced blind.
plainLanguageSummary.D-2: OHTTP privacy only counts with a truly separate front-door operator.
plainLanguageSummary.D-3: No G3 “unlinkable cells” product until someone owns repair and payment.
plainLanguageSummary.D-4: Only run relays yourself for now; no third-party operator recruitment yet.
plainLanguageSummary.D-5: Public HTTPS gateway is its own public product, not part of the privacy story.
plainLanguageSummary.D-6: Drop the extra K_partition secret unless we later prove it is worth the pain.
plainLanguageSummary.D-7: After blind-only writes, you can only roll back to dual-read — never old-only.

coherenceNote.tension: D-1 waits for advanced blind; D-3 defers G3; D-4 self-ops only; D-2 needs independent OHTTP operator
coherenceNote.implication: First public blind canary is blocked until either (a) an independent OHTTP ingress operator exists and OHTTP gates pass, or (b) owner revises D-1 to allow a labelled G2-S self-ops canary as an intermediate step.
doesNotBlock: blind protocol freeze work that removes K_partition (D-6)
